as_told.title: LeMay followed Brown down the steps

plain: The Air Force general Curtis LeMay once went after the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown down a flight of stairs, according to Brown's daughter Linda Brown, who says she saw it. Michels passes the story on in two episodes, calling it a chase and placing it in the 1950s, while Linda Brown, telling it herself, says LeMay "kind of followed my dad down the steps." It is told as a sign that Brown's work had caught the attention of the most senior military men.
